'''Irya Kirsch'''<ref name="Insider">{{InsiderCite|217|Pushing Boundaries}}</ref> was a [[human]] [[Naboo Fighter Pilot]] who served as part of [[Bravo Squadron]]. Kirsch was shot down during the [[Battle of Naboo]],<ref name="TPM" /> in [[32 BBY]].<ref name="Date" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Irya Kirsch first appeared in the film [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], and was played by visual effects worker [[John Knoll]]. Kirsch was first identified in "[[Pushing Boundaries]]," an article published in [[Star Wars Insider 217|''Star Wars Insider'' 217]].<ref name="Insider" /> Their [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] equivalent, [[Rya Kirsch]], was identified in the ''[[Theed Palace Limited]]'' expansion to the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]].<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Theed Palace Limited|cardname=Lieutenant Rya Kirsch}}</ref>
